description: This PHP class provides services related to email configuration management in the OrangeHRM system, including access to data objects and sending test emails.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing email configurations, providing access to the DAO layer and email sending functionalities.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationDao
methods.description: Returns the EmailConfigurationDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Returns the EmailService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: sendTestMail
methods.description: Sends a test email to verify email configurations.
